rows.en: The strongest martial artist, fighting with a host of finishing moves. Masters high-power techniques such as Darkness Finger, Juuni Ouhou Hai Daishahei and Sekiha Tenkyoken.
A demonic Gundam with the three great theoretical functions of Self-Regeneration, Self-Multiplication and Self-Evolution.
Carries no ranged weapons at all, only a high-output beam sword and a heat rod. Like Wing Zero, it is fitted with the Zero System, which is programmed for "perfect victory."
Armed with high-ATK weapons such as a large beam cannon, Fangs and the Egner Whip. Its arms also carry GN Micro Missiles.
Armed with the GN Buster Sword and GN Fangs. It also hides GN Beam Sabers in the toes of both feet.
Armed with the Twin Drive System, GN Buster Rifle, GN Fin Fangs and more, giving it extremely high combat ability.

The form an astronaut stranded on a waterless planet took after turning into a kaiju. Resistant to fire, and breathes 1,000,000-degree flames (Such Fire) itself. On the flip side, it is extremely weak to water.
A humorous kaiju shaped like a mortar. Attacks with spinning body slams and high-heat flames spat from its mouth. Loves rice cakes.
A "Disc Creature" shaped like a teru teru bozu doll. Highly intelligent and wicked. Attacks with a tentacle on its right hand, a sickle on its left and frenzy-inducing gas it breathes out.
An alien that has wandered from star to star, committing every atrocity. Its main weapons are a saber on its right hand, a claw on its left, and a beam fired from the tip of the saber.

Its greatest trait is that its head and body separate and each can act on its own. Sprays misty poison thread from its mouth to numb its target's senses, then breathes 100,000-degree flames to attack.
A Death Army unit fitted with an underwater unit, specialized in underwater combat. Armed with a dedicated trident.
A Death Army unit fitted with a huge flight unit, specialized in aerial combat.
Its nickname "Light-Wave Alien" comes from its whole body being covered in special armor that deflects beams. Fires destructive energy bolts from slits in the shields on both hands.
A plant kaiju from space. Besides releasing pollen that paralyzes the nerves of living things, it catches enemies in its tentacles and squeezes them tight.
A Choju said to have destroyed the lunar civilization long ago. Breathes gas and magma flames from its mouth, and can fire its eyes like missiles.
An alien that looks like Western plate armor. Good at pro-wrestling moves and jump attacks.
An alien from Planet Grost. Its body is frozen, so it has an abnormal hatred of hot things. Its greatest weapon is the freezing ray from both hands.
A male dinosaur-type Yummy born from the Dinosaur Greeed. Besides flying at high speed, it also spews black mist. Stronger than a normal Yummy.
A female dinosaur-type Yummy born from the Dinosaur Greeed. A size smaller than the male, but equal in base ability. Mostly white in color, and stronger than a normal Yummy.
A ferocious bird-type kaiju that feeds on Kemjila, also known as the "Volcano Bird." Its specialties are flamethrower breath and skewering foes with its sharp beak.
A clone created by Devil Gundam.
A kaiju able to revive dead kaiju. Breathes the "Zero-Gravity Ray" from its mouth and flings the feathers on its tail like arrows, controlling them with telekinesis.
Has all the abilities of the Devil Gundam Four Heavenly Kings and combines the features of each in its form. Can use every Four Heavenly Kings technique and also has strong regeneration.
A Greeed of overwhelming power, born from the dinosaur Medals "Ptera," "Tricera" and "Tyranno." Besides fighting hand to hand, it can use purple waves and energy bolts, freeze matter, and even fly.
An evil Ultraman who rebelled against the Land of Light. Once an Ultra Warrior, he could not suppress his lust for power and was banished. Favors attacks using the "Giga Battlenizer."
Devil Gundam's final form. Both shoulders transform into giant claws, the "Devil Fingers."
A giant energy being formed when the three Core Medals "Scorpion," "Crab" and "Shrimp" fused with the Memory Memory. Crushes foes with sheer power and infinite energy.
The ultimate fusion kaiju, born when the grudges in the Monster Graveyard became one. Called the "Hundred-Kaiju," though 100+ are stacked in it. Its "Beryudora Inferno" ray wipes out wide areas.
A four-legged Death Army unit. Armed with a long-range sniping rifle.
An advanced Virgo. Armed with a beam rifle and beam saber, plus Planet Defensor on both shoulders.
An alien who controls the kaiju Samekujira. A cowardly type; its main weapons are the Valky Ring in its hand and the Valky Beam fired from its forehead.
Besides a beam assault rifle and beam saber, it carries six "Funnels" on its shoulders.
True to its nickname "Twin-Headed Kaiju," it has a pair of faces. Breathes high-heat flames from both mouths and burns everything. Physically superior, it overwhelms foes even in melee.
Armed with a grenade launcher, claw shield, beam tomahawk and more. Good at reconnaissance and scouting.
Can carry many weapons, including twin beam guns, a grenade launcher, scatter beam cannon, mini missiles, mega beam cannon and large missiles, for extremely high firepower.
A "Space Quantum Kaiju" whose one body is made of three. Fires a beam from its horns and fireballs from its mouth, and is also good at melee using the claws on both hands.
A Kaima Robot of the Crisis Empire. Its power grows as the artificial sun that is its energy source draws near. Its finisher is the beam fired from both eyes.
An Imagin that took shape from the image of the lion in the tale "The Man Who Found the Golden Lion." Its main weapons are a spiked rod and a claw on its right arm. Its tough skin gives it high DEF.
Armed with beam sabers, a grenade launcher, missile pods and more. Its thruster layout can also be changed freely and often, letting it operate even under immense gravity.
Leader of "Shocker" and "Gel-Shocker." Its true form is a snake-faced monster with one eerie eye. Attacks with energy bolts from both hands, giant snake constriction and snake-mouth fireballs.
Armed with a beam shot rifle, beam tomahawk, scatter mega particle cannon and more. It also carries six large Funnels on its shoulders, and is strong in every stat, including ATK, speed and DEF.
The ultimate Choju "U-Killersaurus," born of Yapool's gathered grudges, powered up by amplified grudges. Armed with six tentacles, the "Saurus Full Burst" destruction ray and many other weapons.

Armed with a scatter mega particle cannon, five-barrel beam cannon, small mega beam cannon and shield. Attacks from its huge body boast stunning destructive power.
A giant form an Imagin takes when defeated, symbolizing creatures that fly. One flap of its wings raises a gale, and it snipes foes from high above with energy needle bullets fired from its tail tip.
A giant four-legged form an Imagin takes when defeated, symbolizing creatures that run the land. Stirs up gales as it leaps and burns foes with hellfire. Its horn charge is fierce too.
Fitted with special gear such as the electromagnetic whip "Egner Whip." It also carries powerful weapons such as a large beam cannon and claw arms.
A super robot of super metal built by the Pedan aliens. Its arms have tremendous destructive force and it fires destruction rays from both eyes. Sturdy armor gives it high offense and defense.
Armed with powerful weapons such as plasma cannons and a plasma field. Also good at close combat with its fighting claws.
Super Shocker's huge flying fortress, once hidden underground. Flies around the sky, wiping out targets with destructive energy bolts and countless claws.
A giant form an Imagin takes when defeated, symbolizing creatures that swim and crawl. Charges while spewing high-heat fireballs. On land, it coils its long body around foes and crushes them.

A robot weapon built for invasion. Its main armament is the triple Gatling gun on its head and the cannon ports on both shoulders, and it hides tremendous potential, such as strong armor and self-repair functions.

A "robot superhuman" made to look like Ultraseven. The only visible differences are the protector-like parts on various places on its body. It has all of Ultraseven's firepower, including the Eye Slugger and beams.
A "Robot Kaiju" disguised as a building under construction. Fires a strange ray from the antenna on its head and shock rays from its chest.
An advanced Psycho Gundam. Armed with Psycommu weapons capable of all-range attacks, such as the Reflector Bits.
Boasts one of the largest bodies of all. Armed with many powerful weapons, including a wired Psycommu mega arm cannon, large Funnels and a chest mega particle cannon.
A strengthened King Joe. Its black stealth body is distinctive, and the "Pedanium Launcher" on its right arm is its finisher. Its original armament has been upgraded across the board.
A giant executive of Dai-Shocker, awakened from a long sleep. Weapons are fitted all over its body.
Unused

A Kamen Rider with the acceleration power sealed in the Accel Memory. Wields the multi-function "Engine Blade" and unleashes big moves with intense acceleration and kick power. Finisher: "Accel Grancer."
The enhanced form Kamen Rider Accel takes with the power of the Trial Memory. Excels at acceleration, and within a 10-second time limit he unleashes super-speed attacks to crush foes.
Armed with an arm beam gun and beam sabers. Poor at melee combat; better at attacking from long range.
A blue Ultraman with the Knight Brace granted by Ultraman King. Once of the Space Science Technology Bureau in the Land of Light. Highly capable in combat, and an excellent scientist as well.
A bird-type Greeed allied with Kamen Rider OOO. Short on Medals, only his right arm has been revived. Calculating and greedy, with a very strong obsession with himself.

The Kamen Rider born right after Rider 1. His base abilities are equal, but he relies on brute force a lot in real combat, so he is called the "Power Rider, No. 2," in contrast to Kamen Rider 1, the "Technique Rider, No. 1."
Armed with the GN Sniper Rifle II and a sniping sensor unit, it excels at sniping that makes use of precise marksmanship. The GN Shield Bits can also block wide-area, multi-angle attacks.

notes.note: Move name romanized: Juuni Ouhou Hai Daishahei (no official English found).
Memory Memory is the Gaia Memory fused with the three Core Medals (uncertain wording).
Pedan aliens: plain English rendering of the race name.
"Great Shocker" for the Dai-Shocker organization; glossary only lists Shocker and Super Shocker.

report: 80/80 rows done; 15 rows are unused-entry placeholders. New terms: Darkness Finger, Juuni Ouhou Hai Daishahei, Egner Whip, Such Fire, Planet Grost, Samekujira, Disc Creature, Eye Slugger, Pedanium Launcher, Pedan aliens, Great Shocker, Accel Grancer, Saurus Full Burst, Beryudora Inferno, Memory Memory, Devil Fingers, Reflector Bits.
